primaryFindings.claim: Polar bears inhabit Arctic sea-ice areas across the Northern Hemisphere; sea ice is a platform used to hunt seals.
Emperor penguin colonies are distributed around the Antarctic continent; most are on fast ice.
Weddell seals are circumpolar coastal animals associated with fast ice; females pup on fast ice.
Adélie penguins live on the Antarctic continent and breed around the Antarctic coast and on small islands with exposed rock.
